name: org.jboss.aerogear.android.unifiedpush.fcm.AeroGearUPSMessageService
description: The JBoss AeroGear Android Push SDK receives Firebase data messages here and forwards them to the app's registered handlers. When Firebase issues a new device token, it also updates the token registered with UnifiedPush.
disableEffect: If disabled, AeroGear messages are not delivered to the app and refreshed device tokens are not registered with UnifiedPush.
